show.description: Humiliated, discarded, and married off to a “bankrupt nobody,” a soft-spoken woman enters hell—only to discover her new husband is a feared mafia heir. As insults turn into bloodshed and love becomes lethal, her broken wedding becomes the fuse for a war no one survives untouched.
